author: Epic Games
description:
There's plunder down under.

The Curse of the Allflame expansion introduces a new challenge league, significant improvements to Abyss and Legion, the return of the Mercenaries of Trarthus, another new Ascendancy Class for the Scion, an all-new endgame system, and much more!

Play Path of Exile for free. https://epic.gm/path-of-exile
title: Path of Exile 1: Curse of the Allflame

author: Epic Games
description:
The MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls Open Beta on PC is here! https://epic.gm/marvel-tokon-beta

Now through July 26, assemble your dream team and experience:  15 playable characters, including Blade
6 stages, including Marvel's New York (Night)
Online Lobby with Casual and Ranked Matches
Local Versus Mode for offline battles
A fully featured Training Mode
Three chapters of The Amazing Guardians' Episode Mode

Don't miss your chance to jump into the Ultimate 4v4 Tag-Team Fighter before launch! MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PC on August 6, 2026!
